subject: Consolidating accelerator allowance with partner vouchers — billing & tax path
messages:
From: Anna Park <anna@foundrylabs.com>
To: irene_choi@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@foundrylabs.com
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 09:24:00 -0700
Subject: Combining Foundry voucher pool with Redwood accelerator allowance

Hi Irene,

Quick note from Foundry — we ran the numbers from our cohort and would like to consolidate the partner vouchers we committed (voucher IDs attached) with the Redwood accelerator allowance you granted earlier this year. The ask: can Redwood apply the partner vouchers as a top-up on the same invoice line as the accelerator allowance so our finance team treats it as a single promotional credit for the cohort?

Two specifics:
- Tax treatment: our accounting team prefers a single credit line to simplify VAT reporting — do you need a separate SOW or is a consolidated invoice fine?
- Timing: we want the consolidation to show on the Oct invoice cycle (invoice date 2026-10-31).

Attached: foundry_vouchers_2026-09.csv (list of voucher codes + amounts). Also looping in procurement for any PO/contract constraints.

Thanks,
Anna Park
Program Manager, Foundry Labs

---
From: irene_choi@redwood.ai
To: Anna Park <anna@foundrylabs.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 15 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Combining Foundry voucher pool with Redwood accelerator allowance

Hi Anna — thanks for the clear breakdown and the CSV. I ran this past finance and legal to confirm options. Short answer: we can consolidate the credits onto one invoice, but we need to confirm two things before Oct 31 cut:

1) Whether Foundry requires a standalone MOU amendment signed by both parties to treat external partner vouchers as an allowance applied by Redwood. If yes, we should use the short addendum route (I attached a quick template).
2) How your AP team needs the tax line labeled ("Promotional credit" vs "Partner voucher"). Redwood's billing system supports a single credit line and we can surface a memo describing the composition of that line.

Next steps I propose:
- If legal sign-off is required, please confirm by EOD Monday 10/18 and I will route the addendum to legal.
- Marissa, can Billing run a demo invoice for the combined credits showing the net and the memo field?

Anna — copying lauren from Partnerships who owns partner voucher policy.

Best,
Irene
Account Executive, Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: foundry_vouchers_2026-09.csv (CSV), draft-addendum-foundry-redwood.docx (DOCX)

---
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: irene_choi@redwood.ai, Anna Park <anna@foundrylabs.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Combining Foundry voucher pool with Redwood accelerator allowance

Irene/Anna — I generated a sample invoice for your review and attached a PDF preview. Key notes from Finance:
- System can present a single credit line labeled as "Promotional credit (Foundry+Redwood)" and include a memo with voucher IDs.
- For US customers, there is no additional VAT, but if Foundry is invoicing an EU entity we will need VAT handling.
- If Foundry wants the voucher amounts to appear as separate sub-lines for internal audit, we can do that too; it will still show as a single net credit on the total.

If Anna confirms the addendum is not required, we can proceed to finalize the Oct 31 invoice. Otherwise, legal will need 2 business days to review the addendum.

Marissa Cole
Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment stub: sample-combined-invoice-2026-10-19.pdf (PDF)

---
From: Anna Park <anna@foundrylabs.com>
To: irene_choi@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, procurement@foundrylabs.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Combining Foundry voucher pool with Redwood accelerator allowance

Thanks — this looks good. Our procurement confirms no addendum required as long as the invoice memo includes voucher IDs and a one-line description. Confirming: please proceed with the combined invoice for Oct 31. Also confirming that the memo will read: "Foundry cohort promotional credit (voucher IDs: see memo) applied to cohort invoice".

If you need a final PO number I'll send it by EOD. Appreciate the quick turnaround — this will make reconciliation much easier for our startups.

Best,
Anna
Program Manager, Foundry Labs
